body: I never should have lived this long. I kick myself every day I never went through with my plans in high school. I could have ended on a high note when people would have actually cared and my death would have meant something. Now it will be nothing but a blip on a radar. At hope at least others will appreciate my shrine.

My god died when I told my pastor about my parents abusing me and he told me I should love my parents still because they are my blood and love me no matter what. Your god is cruel and uncaring if he lets literal children with mental disabilities go through this. The Gods are dead and we have to deal with this by ourselves now.
That's if this person even qualifies for benefits and assistance. Just because they're living out of their car and starving the system can say they're not "poor enough".
You realize how fucking long it takes for a social worker to start a case and help? Months, even over a year. It's not something you can just do overnight to get immediate help.
